description: Friendly 404 page section. Big code numeral + title + description + back-home button + optional suggestion cards. Use as the only section in pages/404.astro.

code.hint: Big numeric code. Override for 500/403 etc.

searchHref.hint: If your site has a search page, add the URL to render a Search button.

suggestions.hint: 2-6 suggestion cards under the main message. Curate the most likely destinations (homepage already covered) — recent blog posts, popular products, pricing.

preview.title: We can't find that page.
preview.description: The link might be old, mistyped, or the page got moved while we were polishing it.
